meta.name: Lord of Mysteries
meta.description: En un mundo victoriano de vapor, barcos de guerra y horrores ocultos, Zhou Mingrui despierta como Klein Moretti. Transita entre la luz y la oscuridad, enzarzado con Iglesias en guerra. Esta es la leyenda de un potencial ilimitado... y de un peligro indescriptible.

videos.title: El Loco
videos.overview: Zhou Mingrui reaparece en una era diferente, en el cuerpo de Klein, quien murió misteriosamente.

videos.title: Beyonder
videos.overview: Klein se encuentra eligiendo un camino que determinará su destino y abrirá la puerta a oscuros secretos.

videos.title: El códice
videos.overview: Klein se embarca en una búsqueda para recuperar el cuaderno de la familia Antigonus.

videos.title: El espejo mágico
videos.overview: Klein acude al maestro Neil para aprender magia ritual... que deberá poner pronto en práctica.

videos.title: El héroe
videos.overview: La tragedia desatada en un barco levanta las sospechas de los Halcones Nocturnos e inician una investigación.

videos.title: El profesor
videos.overview: Tras una misión a unas ruinas malditas, Klein descubre algo inesperado relacionado con el profesor Azik.

videos.title: Coincidence
videos.overview: When too many coincidences appear, Klein Moretti discovers he may be caught in an elaborate scheme.

videos.title: Losing Control
videos.overview: Klein Moretti is on a mission, and the most dreaded fate that could happen to a Beyonder becomes reality.

videos.title: Party
videos.overview: Klein succeeds in ascending to Sequence 8, but this glorious moment is overshadowed by an event.

videos.title: Clue
videos.overview: Dunn and Klein attend the scene of a possibly supernatural murder of a congressman.

videos.title: Mastermind
videos.overview: Following Klein's suspicions, the Nighthawk investigates what Sharon Khoy is hiding.

videos.title: The Bomb
videos.overview: Lanevus threatens to destroy Tingen, putting the Nighthawks in check.

videos.title: Light
videos.overview: The Nighthawks defend Tingen from evil's descent, and past events are revealed to be more than coincidences.

videos.title: Episodio 1
videos.overview: Mysticism class on the geographical distribution of the Northern Continent and the world's languages.

videos.title: Lord of Mysteries Chibi - 01 - Zhou Mingrui's Unlucky Day
videos.overview: Life is tough when you're Zhou Mingrui.

videos.title: Old Neil's Mysticism Class - Lesson 2
videos.overview: Mysticism class on Beyonder pathways, the Nighthawks, and Spirit vision.

videos.title: Lord of Mysteries Chibi - 02 - Buying a Cane
videos.overview: Buying a cane is serious business.

videos.title: Old Neil's Mysticism Class - Lesson 3
videos.overview: Mysticism class on the Seer, Corpse Collector, and Sleepless pathways, from Sequence 9 to Sequence 7.

videos.title: Lord of Mysteries Chibi - 03 - Ending the Lease
videos.overview: Ending a lease early isn't easy, but Klein Moretti's got a trick up his sleeve.

videos.title: Old Neil's Mysticism Class - Lesson 4
videos.overview: Mysticism class on ritualistic magic, honorific names, and basic knowledge about the Mystery Pryer pathway.

videos.title: Lord of Mysteries Chibi - 04 - The Divination Club
videos.overview: Klein Moretti proves that he's the real deal to the Divination Club.

videos.title: Old Neil's Mysticism Class - Lesson 5
videos.overview: Mysticism class on the Assassin pathway and the monetary system of the Loen Kingdom.

videos.title: Lord of Mysteries Chibi - 05 - Old Neil's Opportunistic Strategies
videos.overview: Old Neil teaches Klein how to take advantage of reimbursements.

videos.title: Old Neil's Mysticism Class - Lesson 6
videos.overview: Mysticism class on orthodox organizations, hidden organizations, and taboos.

videos.title: Lord of Mysteries Chibi - 06 - The Cute Newcomer and the Old Veteran
videos.overview: Klein works with Leonard on a mission.

videos.title: Old Neil's Mysticism Class - Lesson 7
videos.overview: Neil explains the different uses of spiritualism through different Sequences.

videos.title: Lord of Mysteries Chibi - 07 - The Tale of the 1,000 Pounds
videos.overview: Alger quickly needs a large sum of money.

videos.title: Old Neil's Mysticism Class - Lesson 8
videos.overview: Introduction to the ways of losing control after consuming potions and the Forsaken Land of the Gods.

videos.title: Lord of Mysteries Chibi - 08 - The Mr. Fool in My Heart
videos.overview: The Tarot Club talks about Mr. Fool.

videos.title: Lord of Mysteries Chibi - 09 - Klein's Nightmare
videos.overview: Dunn has taken the role of Nightmare too literally.

videos.title: Lord of Mysteries Special: City of Silver
videos.overview: A young man from a place without sunlight prays to the Fool and discovers the Tarot Club.

videos.title: The Marked Hunt (1)
videos.overview: Alger Wilson discovers his lifelong friend is after his life and moves to make a preemptive strike.

videos.title: The Marked Hunt (2)
videos.overview: Audrey Hall attends a social ball and discovers a great danger lurking behind a disguise.
